policy: Only a new third-party video genuinely reacting to, critiquing or analysing a Missioned Souls musical performance is valid. Concert/event announcements, unrelated member projects (Paper Dove), tributes, original covers, view milestones, general websites and archives without new reaction are not valid.
source: 2026-10-22 real YouTube snippet/description snapshot and explicit user clarification to reactions only
provenance: These adjudications use title, video-specific descriptions, and user notes. They do not replace the raw labels, do not independently watch each video, and are not independently video-verified ground truth.

categories.supported_reaction: Looks like a third-party performance reaction from specific published metadata AND previous user match; provisional until reactions-only video-level confirmation
categories.exclude_by_reactions_only_policy: Video-specific metadata or user note conflicts with strictly performance-reaction scope
categories.recheck_video: Insufficient video-specific evidence to determine whether an actual performance reaction occurs; no automatic notification
